Route Info Breakdown - Types of Transportation/Team Challenge

Explanation of Tables:
"Challenges" involve any part of the Route Info that is not actively traveling somewhere or picking up the clue from a club box. Some Route Info clues are only comprised of Challenges, which I included as the second column below.
"Flights", "Buses", "Taxis", "Boats", "Driving", "Bikes" are all exactly how they appear.
"Running" includes specific verbage in the clue for teams to travel through physical strength, such as hiking or swimming. All route infos include some form of running, this indicator is for that specific verbage.
"Animals" include riding on top of an animal to reach a destination away from the start point. Leading an animal is a challenge.
"Random Rides" are any form of transport not mentioned above, such as ziplines and gondolas.
